prompt: Create ONE complete 16-frame landing animation SPRITE SHEET for Bullets of Fury, premium HD Neo Geo arcade sprite art. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, chronological left to right then top to bottom. True transparent background. Do not move the whole ship up or down to represent descent: the engine will position the fixed sprite. No extra wings, no extra engines, no invented third nacelle.
